  Type: exterior
  Time of Day: late morning
  Description: A wide concrete promenade running along the top of a painted sea wall above Bondi Beach. Low white-painted concrete wall in the foreground, sand and breaking surf beyond, surfers cresting waves in the mid-ground, headland and apartment blocks distant. Windy, bright, open sky.

- Location ID: loc_3

Interior visible as a shallow dark slot behind Scarlett as she leans out with a sweating paper cup of frozen pineapple.
  Architectural Style: Simple gloss-white painted beach kiosk with aluminium sliding service window and shallow awning
  Key Features: Service hatch and counter ledge; sweating paper cup of pineapple; menu board; glossy white paintwork
